synthesize_tts_audio: synthesize text to audio WAV file using KittenTTS model with configurable voice
create_tts_instance: create a TTS instance that loads KittenML/kitten-tts-mini-0.8 model and configured voice
synthesize_custom_output: synthesize text to a custom output WAV file path using TTS class
build_tts_audio_pipeline: build an audio generation pipeline using TTS class to convert text to WAV at 24kHz
test_tts_synthesize: test the TTS synthesize method with sample text and verify WAV output file
